main_measure.name: 3-day forward return minus the coin's normal 3-day drift, top-fifth forecast in-rise grid bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, same-day cases taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 (and top-minus-bottom > 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess top fifth minus bottom fifth in-rise (Welch t 5.593)

decided_by: The main-measure mean is above 0 with t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom difference is above 0.
reading: The top and bottom fifths are the in-rise (5-day return > 0) bars of the 3-bar grid, pooled over all coins and windows, with forecast at or above the 80th (at or below the 20th) percentile of those bars' forecasts; the day-clustered t sums each day's deviations with a G/(G-1) correction, and the minimum count missed makes the status not observable.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
